document.download.expires: This download link works for {seconds} seconds.
document.scan.infected: A problem was found. The file was not kept.
document.scan.simulation: Development test scanner, not a real malware scan.
document.scan.unavailable: Not scanned. This file cannot be published until a scan passes.
document.upload.unsupported: Only PDF, PNG, JPEG, text and CSV files are accepted.
emergency.no_ads: Emergency alerts never carry advertisements or links.
emergency.rate_limited: Too many emergency alerts were sent recently. Please wait before sending another.
notice.ai_draft.label: Drafted with an AI assistant
notice.ai_draft.needs_approval: A person must read and approve this draft before it is published.
notice.published_immutable: A published notice never changes. A correction is a new version.
notice.translation.review_required: Legal and safety notices need a person to review every translation before publishing.
notice.translation.unreviewed: Not yet checked by a person. The original text is the one that counts.
poll.answered: Your answer is recorded. You can answer once.
poll.non_binding_hint: This poll asks for opinions only. It does not decide anything.
poll.visibility.after_close: Results are shown after the poll closes
poll.visibility.managers_only: Results are shown to the committee only
poll.wording.flagged: The wording may lead people to one answer. Please review it.
